title: I backtested Serenity's stock picks. The results surprised me.
author: hialdu
selftext:
I've been following Serenity (@AleabitoReddit) for a while because she consistently posts deep research on semis, memory, AI infrastructure and networking.

I wondered whether those ideas actually translated into investment performance.

So I recreated her recommendations into a rules-based portfolio where every recommendation becomes a rebalance.

**Backtest (Apr 9 – Jun 23):**

• +46.07% return  
• 42 trades  
• 89.5% win rate  
• Max drawdown -14.8%

Obviously this is **only a backtest**, not live performance.

What I found interesting wasn't just the return. Looking through the trade log, the portfolio consistently rotated through AI infrastructure names like ARM, AAOI, MRVL, ONTO, NVTS, CAMT, TSEM and others as her thesis evolved.

Being able to inspect every rebalance and every simulated trade makes it much easier to evaluate someone's ideas instead of judging them by screenshots or hindsight.

**Would you guys be interested if I analyzed more finance creators this way? Who should I test next?**
